profile.name: Aisyah Nuraini
profile.title: AI Engineer | Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist
profile.tagline: Building agentic AI systems that ship — from a Telegram message to a published, SEO-compliant article.
summary: I build agentic AI systems that ship — not just notebooks. At PT Gosyen Solusi Indonesia, I've shipped a stack of Claude- and OpenAI-powered agents in production: an n8n pipeline that turns a Telegram message into a published WordPress article, a custom MCP server that lets Claude Desktop publish SEO-compliant posts from a single title, and NanoClaw/OpenClaw agents for scheduled and on-demand reporting.

My research background spans transformer NLP (BERT/ALBERT), explainable AI (SHAP/LIME), and computer vision in healthcare — including kidney lesion detection from CT scans. That's where the modeling instincts come from; what I enjoy most is turning that foundation into agents people actually trust and rely on.
profile.focus: Deepening the agentic AI engineering track: MCP server architecture, Claude/OpenAI agent orchestration (n8n, GitHub Actions), and RAG with pgvector/Supabase.

projects.name: WordPress MCP Connector for Claude Desktop
projects.description: Custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connecting WordPress to Claude Desktop — generate and publish a fully SEO-compliant article from just a title, 96% hands-off.
projects.overview: Built an MCP server that exposes WordPress publishing as tools Claude Desktop can call directly. Typing only an article title into Claude Desktop is enough to trigger drafting, on-page SEO formatting (keyword placement, internal linking, meta fields), and publishing straight to WordPress. About 96% of the workflow, from draft to live post, now runs without manual intervention.
highlights: Custom MCP server exposing WordPress actions as Claude Desktop tools
Single-input workflow: title in, SEO-compliant published article out
Enforces on-page SEO rules automatically on every generated post
Cut manual publishing steps by 96%

projects.name: AI Article Publishing Automation (n8n + Telegram + OpenAI)
projects.description: n8n workflow that turns a Telegram message (article title + image) into a fully formatted, SEO-ready WordPress post via OpenAI — removing manual publishing steps.
projects.overview: Built for GSI's content team: send an article title and an attached image to a Telegram bot, and an n8n workflow orchestrates an OpenAI model to draft the article body, format it for WordPress, and publish it directly via the WordPress REST API. Roughly 80% of the publishing workflow — drafting, formatting, and posting — runs unattended after the Telegram trigger, with the remaining share reserved for editorial review.
highlights: Telegram bot trigger accepting title + image, parsed by n8n
OpenAI-powered article drafting and formatting pipeline
Direct publish to WordPress via REST API — 80% hands-off
Removed manual copy-paste steps from the editorial workflow

projects.name: Uno GSI Content Generator
projects.description: WordPress plugin for AI-driven, SEO-compliant content generation, iteratively built across versions 2.7–2.9.x with migrations between OpenAI and Gemini APIs — cut manual configuration by 87%.
projects.overview: Built for GSI's SEO content team to turn a topic + target keyword list into publish-ready, SEO-aware articles directly inside the WordPress admin dashboard. Iterated across multiple versions to swap and combine AI providers (OpenAI GPT-4o/GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5 Flash) for cost and quality, add prompt caching to cut API spend, and enforce on-page SEO rules (internal linking, anchor text, keyword placement) automatically on every generated article — cutting manual setup and configuration time by 87% and driving measurable growth in organic visits.
highlights: Integrated OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1) and Gemini 2.5 Flash, including prompt caching
Rule-based SEO engine cutting manual configuration by 87%
Internal linking system with zone-spreading logic
WP-Cron self-ping mechanism to recover stuck jobs

projects.name: NanoClaw — Claude-Powered Cron Reporting Agent
projects.description: Lightweight scheduled agent built on the Claude API that runs cron-based tasks and delivers daily reporting automatically.
projects.overview: NanoClaw is a minimal agent wrapper around the Claude API for recurring operational tasks. Scheduled cron jobs trigger Claude to compile and format a daily report, which is then dispatched automatically — removing the need for someone to manually pull data and write it up every day.
highlights: Claude API-driven task execution on a cron schedule
Automated daily reporting with no manual trigger needed
Built as a lightweight, single-purpose agent rather than a full framework

projects.name: OpenClaw Telegram Sales Reporting Agent
projects.description: Telegram-based agent (OpenClaw) that generates and delivers daily sales reports on request, replacing a manual end-of-day reporting process.
projects.overview: Deployed OpenClaw as a Telegram-accessible agent for GSI's sales team: a message to the bot triggers the agent to pull the latest sales data, summarize it, and return a formatted daily report directly in the chat — no separate dashboard login required.
highlights: Telegram-native interface — report generation without leaving the chat
On-demand and scheduled daily sales report generation
Cut manual reporting time for the sales team

projects.name: Automated Sales Reporting — Claude + GitHub Actions
projects.description: Scheduled sales-reporting pipeline using the Claude API and GitHub Actions cron jobs, distributing reports automatically to email, Telegram, and WhatsApp.
projects.overview: Built a GitHub Actions workflow, scheduled via cron, that calls the Claude API to compile and format a sales report, then fans it out across three channels — email, Telegram, and WhatsApp — so stakeholders get the same report wherever they check first, with no one manually compiling or sending it.
highlights: GitHub Actions cron job orchestrating the full reporting pipeline
Claude API used to compile and format the sales report
Multi-channel delivery: email, Telegram, and WhatsApp
Fully automated — no manual generation or distribution

projects.name: HR Inventory (AssetFlow)
projects.description: Asset and inventory management system for GSI, vibe-coded full-stack end to end with Claude. Separates asset master data, borrowing transaction logs, and consumable stock into distinct modules with clean referential structure.
projects.overview: AssetFlow replaces a manual, spreadsheet-based process for tracking company assets, ATK (office supplies) requests, vehicle bookings, room bookings, and maintenance requests across GSI's HR/GA division. Built module by module through AI-assisted (vibe coding) development with Claude — asset master data, borrowing transaction logs, and consumable stock are kept as distinct tables with clean referential structure, with role-based dashboards for staff, HR, and direktur so each role only sees what's relevant to them.
highlights: Full-stack system vibe-coded end to end with Claude
Supabase Auth with role-based access control (super_admin, hr, direktur)
Audit logging with Realtime subscriptions
Deployed via Nginx + Bun on a VPS

projects.name: Station Command Center
projects.description: Concept and prototype for a security/operations dashboard for a transit station — CCTV AI detection, patrol logging, attendance, and incident management in one system.
projects.overview: A single command-center concept for station operations teams: live CCTV feeds run through a YOLOv8 detection service for flood and trash monitoring, while patrol rounds (e-Patrol), staff attendance (e-Presensi), and incidents are logged and tracked in the same dashboard. Built as a full-stack prototype to validate the architecture — a Socket.IO layer pushes detection events to the dashboard in real time, with the Python AI service kept decoupled from the Node.js backend via Docker.
highlights: YOLOv8-based CCTV detection for flood and trash monitoring
e-Patrol, e-Presensi, and incident management modules
Full-stack architecture: Node.js/Express/Socket.IO backend, Next.js frontend, Python AI service, Docker

projects.name: License Plate Detection & OCR
projects.description: Computer vision pipeline combining YOLOv8 for plate detection with a CRNN model for OCR, with iterative work on dataset structure and model accuracy.
projects.overview: A two-stage pipeline: YOLOv8 localizes the license plate within a full vehicle image, then a CRNN model reads the characters off the cropped plate region. Most of the iteration time went into dataset structure — fixing path/labeling issues that were silently hurting OCR accuracy — and into tuning augmentation to make character recognition robust to blur, angle, and lighting variation.
highlights: YOLOv8 detection stage tuned for plate localization
CRNN-based OCR stage for character recognition
Debugged dataset path issues and improved accuracy through iteration

projects.name: Cyberbullying Detection with Explainable AI
projects.description: Transformer-based NLP research project detecting cyberbullying, paired with explainability methods so predictions can be understood rather than trusted blindly.
projects.overview: Fine-tunes BERT and ALBERT on a large-scale Indonesian cyberbullying dataset, then applies SHAP and LIME on top of the classifier so flagged content comes with a reason, not just a label — important for a use case where False positives have real moderation consequences. Later extended with an incremental-learning setup so the model can adapt to new slang and patterns without full retraining, and published as part of ongoing research with the Dian Nuswantoro Computer Club.
highlights: Fine-tuned BERT/ALBERT for cyberbullying classification
Applied SHAP and LIME to explain model predictions
Part of a broader ML research background spanning medical imaging and multilingual speech-to-text

projects.name: Multilingual Indonesian–English Speech-to-Text (Whisper)
projects.description: Whisper-based speech-to-text system handling mixed Indonesian and English audio, including code-switching between the two languages within a single utterance.
projects.overview: Built and evaluated a multilingual speech-to-text pipeline on top of OpenAI's Whisper model, targeting Indonesian and English audio — including code-switched speech where speakers mix both languages in the same sentence, a common pattern in Indonesian conversational audio. Work covered dataset preprocessing, noise handling, and evaluation across clean and noisy audio conditions to support the NLU pipeline of a Virtual Smart Assistant (VSA) product.
highlights: Evaluated Whisper on Indonesian–English bilingual and code-switched audio
Built a preprocessing pipeline for noisy, real-world audio conditions
Supported the NLU pipeline for a Virtual Smart Assistant (VSA) product

projects.name: Medical Disease Classification (CNN & Class-Imbalance Handling)
projects.description: Applied deep learning classification for pneumonia detection from chest X-rays and early-stage diabetes detection from clinical data, with a focus on handling class imbalance.
projects.overview: Two applied classification efforts within the same medical imaging/data research track: a fine-tuned InceptionV3 CNN for pneumonia detection from chest X-ray images, and a deep learning pipeline for early-stage diabetes detection that specifically addresses class imbalance in the underlying dataset — a common failure point in medical classification where the positive class is under-represented.
highlights: Fine-tuned InceptionV3 CNN for chest X-ray pneumonia detection
Deep learning pipeline for early-stage diabetes detection with class-imbalance handling
Part of an ongoing medical imaging/data research track
